audit.whatIsWrong: Lane was labelled EVEN at 6/10 difficulty despite a 60.17% win rate, and the Levels 4-5 row said 'Skill' while its own why calls it 'your hardest zone-control stretch'.
audit.why: 60.17% over 118 games is a favoured lane, and the packet chart puts Heimerdinger ahead at 4-5. Everything except the enum fields already read as favoured.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN -> FAV, diffRating 6/10 -> 4.5/10, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t matched; win[3]/phases[3].side -> Heimerdinger with rating 7/10 and a why that says what that row is.

audit.why: Four spikes, all real: your 2-3 chip wall, your 4-5 nest peak, her level-6 disguised Pop Blossom, your first-item siege. Level 6 is correctly hers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs was described as 'extends through targets' with no cooldown and no statement of what actually changes. Pop Blossom's hidden wind-up was in the prose but not in the cooldown reference. dontsFull[1] carried the generic 'burning it for tiny value' filler.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range and becomes larger, faster and a longer root once it passes through a champion — so standing behind a teammate makes it worse, not safer. Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s and Riot's text says the preparation is hidden while she is disguised, which is the whole level-6 threat.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now gives 12s Tangle-Barbs with the pass-through upgrade stated, 120s Pop Blossom with the hidden wind-up, and your 11s grenade. dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[2].d now carry the root's real number instead of filler.

audit.why: Packet flagged spikes[2] 'Pop Blossom's' as a probable wrong ability name. It is the correct name in possessive form — a false positive.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Peak zone control — three banked charges plus the grenade stun make any clone-disguised walk-up into your nest suicidal.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Tangle-Barbs and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4.5/10. Favoured — the lane is decided by dodging Tangle-Barbs and never facechecking her clone.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Neeko carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Neeko carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 12s at rank 1 — it grows and roots for longer after passing through a champion, so never stand behind a teammate. - Pop Blossom: 120s, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. - Your grenade: 11s — save it for her commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and roots everything it passes through.

edits.before: Neeko wastes Tangle-Barbs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Her root missed: 12s of a squishy, dashless Neeko in your beams.
